mapper.insert: INSERT INTO personal_match_participant ( user_id, personal_match_id, attendance, applied_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{personalMatchId}, #{attendance}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO personal_match_participant ( user_id, personal_match_id, attendance, status, payment_id, applied_at
) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{personalMatchId}, #{attendance}, #{status}, #{paymentId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.nickname, COALESCE(AVG(r.score), 0) AS avg_rating_score FROM personal_match_participant p JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user_rating r ON r.receiver_user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.personal_match_id = #{personalMatchId} AND (p.status IS NULL OR p.status != '취소') GROUP BY u.user_id, u.nickname;
